shadows.name: card-float
shadows.purpose: Stat cards and list containers that should feel lightly lifted off the ground.

shadows.name: hero-lift
shadows.purpose: The hero card and NavCards — heavier weight than card-float.

shadows.name: frame-lift
shadows.purpose: The desktop content card inside the layout frame — warm shadow color to match the warm layoutSurface it sits on.

shadows.name: fab-lift
shadows.purpose: The floating action button, most elevated element on mobile.

motion.name: hover-press-spring
motion.purpose: Every Pressable's felt response — see src/presentation/shared/hover.ts useHoverPress.

garden-display.purpose: Bundled Anton; size min(58, (measured hero column width - 52) / 6.1), line height 1.04. Compact header uses 38. Ordinary body fonts remain unchanged.

garden-wordmark.purpose: Existing Plus Jakarta Sans 800 file loaded locally via expo-font; native weight 400 avoids synthetic bold.

layout.keyboard: No ScrollView. Fixed KeyboardAvoidingView/View; keyboard hides hero and secondary accessories, forms remain mounted, login/signup gaps become 8.
layout.availableHeight: Measured frame minus form height scales photograph into remaining hero area; short-height fallback uses a leaf-color wordmark strip. Small screens and large Dynamic Type need native captures.

compactForms.behavior: One mounted field visible at a time; Continue until final field, then existing submit. 44px back action; drafts preserved and effect focuses active field after keyboard step changes. Zero/unmeasured or roomy frames retain the whole form. Password strength hides with keyboard; password-length hint remains.

layout.heroMeasurementReset: Width, fontScale, compact, title, subtitle and font-loaded state reset text measurement and recalculate fallback.
layout.householdKeyboard: Hide intent selector, explanation, paste/scan, tour and sign-out; keep active name/code field and submit.

asset.purpose: Generated transparent photographic carrots and pear; decorative, excluded from accessibility.

validation.reason: Native computer-use permissions blocked two capture attempts. Static source review found tablet sizing tied to viewport; corrected to measured hero column. Rendered fidelity remains unverified.
validation.costlyCommands: No tests, builds, lint or typechecks executed per AGENTS.md.
validation.focusedTests: Two compact-form step/draft/submission tests added, not executed per AGENTS.md.

garden.providers: Single horizontal row with real icons, short names, full accessibility labels, pending spinners and disabling; separate email action. Apple retains native signInAsync and existing official logo asset.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Full-pill lime button, used for the primary auth action.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background:#C4E538; color:#0F2B1D; height:50px; padding:0 24px; border:none; border-radius:999px; font-weight:800; font-size:14px; transition:transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { transform:scale(1.035); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform:scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid #0F2B1D; outline-offset:2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Outlined pill button, used for PocketID sign-in.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background:transparent; color:#6B5642; height:50px; padding:0 24px; border:2px solid #6B5642; border-radius:999px; font-weight:800; font-size:14px; transition:transform 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { transform:scale(1.035); } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform:scale(0.96); }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Auth form input — cream fill, lime focus border.
components.css: .ds-field label { display:block; font-size:12px; font-weight:600; color:#6B7280; margin-bottom:6px; } .ds-input { height:48px; width:100%; border-radius:14px; padding:0 16px; font-size:14px; color:#16211A; background:#FDF6E8; border:2px solid transparent; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color:#C4E538; outline:none; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.css: .ds-chip-fresh { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:4px; background:#DFF3E4; color:#1F6B44; padding:4px 8px; border-radius:999px; font-size:10px; font-weight:700; }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: Pastel card with a saturated icon chip, label, and bold value.
components.css: .ds-stat-card { background:#FDF6E8; border-radius:26px 14px 26px 14px; padding:16px; box-shadow:0 10px 18px rgba(15,43,29,0.1); } .ds-stat-chip { width:36px; height:36px; border-radius:12px; background:#FF8A3D; display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; margin-bottom:8px; } .ds-stat-label { font-size:12px; font-weight:500; color:#7A6B47; } .ds-stat-value { font-size:22px; font-weight:800; color:#16211A; margin-top:4px; }

components.name: Sidebar Nav Item
components.description: Desktop sidebar nav row — lime pill when active, transparent when not.
components.css: .ds-nav-item { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:10px 12px; border-radius:999px; background:transparent; color:#16211A; font-weight:700; font-size:13px; border:none; width:100%; text-align:left; } .ds-nav-item--active { background:#C4E538; color:#0F2B1D; }

components.name: Garden Primary Button
components.description: Scoped 50px minimum action; existing accent lime in both themes. Pending shows spinner and label.

components.name: Garden Provider Row
components.description: One horizontal row, real provider icons and visible short names, 68px minimum controls. Preview shows PocketID; native component uses each provider’s actual asset. Apple keeps its official logo and native signInAsync. Email action is separate.

components.name: Garden Text Field
components.description: Transparent 48px minimum field; muted 2px outline becomes ink on focus. Native trailing action keeps 44px touch width.

components.name: Garden Household Intent
components.description: Leaf selected intent beside a transparent outlined option; one branch visible, drafts retained.

narrative.overview: Garde-manger reads as a fitness-app-bright kitchen dashboard: a near-white mint-to-white ground that feels like morning light through a window, one warm-mocha hero surface anchoring the eye like the one wooden shelf in an otherwise bright pantry, and lime accents standing in for fresh produce — the one saturated color the system spends on doing (progress, primary actions), never on decorating. The system went through two corrections to get here: the original hero card was near-black forest green ("too corporate," per feedback) and was warmed into mocha with an ember glow; the desktop layout surround was originally that same dark mocha ("too much brown") and was pulled all the way down to a near-white warm gray so the white content card would still read as the lighter of the two.
keyCharacteristics: Near-white mint blob ground on mobile; near-white warm-gray surround with an inset white content card on tablet/desktop.
Exactly one dark, rich surface per screen carries the high-contrast hero role.
Lime is reserved for interactive/progress meaning, never decoration.
Asymmetric corner radii per major card, never one uniform radius.
Every status is icon + color + word.
Every pressable spring-scales on hover and press.

rules.name: The One Dark Surface Rule
rules.body: Exactly one surface per screen is allowed to be rich/dark. Two dark surfaces means the hierarchy broke.

rules.name: The Layer Must Lighten Rule
rules.body: layoutSurface must always be visibly darker than gradientBottom, or the inset-card effect disappears.

rules.name: The Size-and-Weight-Only Rule
rules.body: No token uses color to create hierarchy between a label and its value.

rules.name: The Warm-Shadow-on-Warm-Ground Rule
rules.body: A shadow cast onto layoutSurface uses a warm shadow color (#3A2E20); onto the mint/white ground, the cooler #0F2B1D.

rules.name: The No-Uniform-Radius Rule
rules.body: If two adjacent cards in a row share an identical corner radius, pull one of the three named corner sets instead.

rules.name: The Recognizable Garden Rule
rules.body: Keep the chosen Garden composition recognizable through its broad organic field, condensed display headline, photographic carrots and pear, cream ground and outlined controls. The latest user instruction adapts only colors to the existing mobile palette, puts providers in one horizontal row and removes auth/onboarding ScrollViews. Ordinary body type, native behavior and surrounding screens stay intact.

dos: Do keep layoutSurface visibly lighter-than-mocha but darker than gradientBottom.
Do pair every status color with its icon and word.
Do give every new major card its own asymmetric corner set.
Do set minHeight:0 on every flex:1 box in a chain that ends in a ScrollView.
Do hover/press-scale every new Pressable via useHoverPress.
Do disclose a placeholder honestly rather than shipping a silently dead control.
Do preserve the recognizable Garden composition within entry screens while keeping ordinary body type, native behavior and the surrounding application system.
donts: Don't use chip-teal/chip-violet/chip-orange behind white text.
Don't add a second dark/high-contrast surface to a screen that already has the hero card.
Don't add a visible border/stroke to any container.
Don't hardcode an SVG gradient id as a literal string on a component that can mount more than once in the same DOM.
Don't treat source inspection or panel component previews as proof of native Garden fidelity; compare real captures to the chosen comp before a ship verdict.
